steps.code:
# Get all recommended songs (paginate)
access_token = login_response['access_token']
all_recommendations = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    recs = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not recs:
        break
    all_recommendations.extend(recs)
    if len(recs) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total recommendations: {len(all_recommendations)}")
print(all_recommendations[:3])
